words.enDefinition: options that make a device or service easier to use for people with different access needs

examples.en: I opened accessibility settings to adjust how the text looked on my new tablet.
examples.zh: 我打开「无障碍设置」，调整了新平板上的文字显示。

examples.en: The assistant showed us where to find accessibility settings on the library computers.
examples.zh: 工作人员给我们指了图书馆电脑上的「无障碍设置」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a quick way to turn an accessibility feature on or off

examples.en: I set up an accessibility shortcut to turn the magnifier on during my reading.
examples.zh: 我设置了一个「无障碍快捷操作」，阅读时可以快速打开放大镜。

examples.en: The tutor showed me which accessibility shortcut was available on the computer in class.
examples.zh: 导师给我看了教室电脑可以用哪个「无障碍快捷操作」。

words.enDefinition: software that presents digital text and interface elements through speech or braille

examples.en: The library website works with a screen reader when I look up books for class.
examples.zh: 我查上课要用的书时，可以用「屏幕阅读器」浏览图书馆网站。

examples.en: We used a screen reader to check the labels on the society's signup form.
examples.zh: 我们用「屏幕阅读器」检查社团报名表上的标签。

words.enDefinition: technology that converts written text into spoken audio

examples.en: I used text-to-speech to listen to the assigned reading while looking at the diagrams.
examples.zh: 我用「文字转语音」听指定读物，同时看其中的图表。

examples.en: The note-taking app offers text-to-speech for students who prefer listening to their notes.
examples.zh: 笔记应用为更喜欢听笔记的学生提供「文字转语音」。

words.enDefinition: technology that converts spoken words into written text

examples.en: I used speech-to-text to turn our recorded interview into a written transcript.
examples.zh: 我用「语音转文字」把访谈录音转成了一份文字稿。

examples.en: The speech-to-text feature missed my tutor's name, so I corrected it in the notes.
examples.zh: 「语音转文字」没识别出导师的名字，我就在笔记里改了一下。

words.enDefinition: entering text in a document or field by speaking rather than typing

examples.en: I used voice typing to draft a short email when my hands were tired.
examples.zh: 手累的时候，我用「语音输入」起草了一封简短的邮件。

examples.en: The instructor explained how to start voice typing in the shared document before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，导师解释了如何在共享文档里开始「语音输入」。

words.enDefinition: an accessibility control that reads the text displayed on the current screen aloud

examples.en: I enabled Speak Screen so I could listen to the reading while preparing dinner.
examples.zh: 我开启了「朗读屏幕」，这样准备晚饭时也能听阅读材料。

examples.en: The adviser demonstrated Speak Screen on a long page from the student support website.
examples.zh: 顾问用学生支持网站上较长的页面演示了「朗读屏幕」。

words.enDefinition: a control that reads a selected piece of text aloud

examples.en: I turned on Speak Selection to hear unfamiliar words while reading the course notes.
examples.zh: 我打开了「朗读所选内容」，用来听课程笔记里不熟悉的单词。

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated Speak Selection on one line from the handout on her tablet.
examples.zh: 导师在平板上用讲义中的一行字演示了「朗读所选内容」。

words.enDefinition: a tool that enlarges all or part of what appears on a screen

examples.en: The screen magnifier made the small labels in the timetable easier to read.
examples.zh: 「屏幕放大镜」让我更容易看清时间表上的小字。

examples.en: I used a screen magnifier to check the notes in the margin carefully.
examples.zh: 我用「屏幕放大镜」仔细查看页边的笔记。

words.enDefinition: a setting that changes how large the device's interface appears across the screen

examples.en: I increased display zoom so the app icons were easier to see from farther away.
examples.zh: 我调大了「显示缩放」，这样离得远一点也更容易看清应用图标。

examples.en: My tablet's display zoom made the menu items larger while I was reading in class.
examples.zh: 上课阅读时，我用平板的「显示缩放」把菜单选项放大了。

words.enDefinition: changing the relative size of text across a device or interface

examples.en: I increased text scaling to make the reading app easier to use between classes.
examples.zh: 我调大了「文字缩放」，课间看阅读应用更轻松了。

examples.en: The timetable remained readable after I changed text scaling on the university's loan tablet.
examples.zh: 我在学校借来的平板上调整「文字缩放」后，时间表依然看得清。

words.enDefinition: a setting that makes supported interface text appear in heavier strokes

examples.en: I set my phone to use bold text to make the menu labels clearer.
examples.zh: 我把手机设成「粗体文本」，让菜单上的字更清楚。

examples.en: The librarian switched on bold text while we adjusted the borrowed tablet for reading.
examples.zh: 我们调整借来的平板以便阅读时，馆员开启了「粗体文本」。

words.enDefinition: the displayed size of the on-screen pointer that you move with a mouse or trackpad

examples.en: I increased the pointer size so students could follow it from the back row.
examples.zh: 我调大了「鼠标指针大小」，让后排学生也能跟上指针的位置。

examples.en: The classroom computer had a different pointer size from the one in the library.
examples.zh: 教室电脑的「鼠标指针大小」与图书馆那台不同。

words.enDefinition: a visual marker that makes the place where typed text will appear easier to see

examples.en: I enabled the text cursor indicator to find where I was typing in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我打开了「文本光标指示器」，方便在练习表里找到当前输入的位置。

examples.en: The text cursor indicator helped me find my place when editing the presentation notes.
examples.zh: 编辑演示备注时，「文本光标指示器」让我更容易找到编辑位置。

collocations: change the text cursor indicator colour

words.enDefinition: a strong visual difference between elements such as text and the background

examples.en: I prefer high contrast when reading long course documents on my laptop in daylight.
examples.zh: 我在白天用笔记本看较长的课程文件时，更喜欢「高对比度」。

examples.en: The campus website uses high contrast for the labels in its navigation menu.
examples.zh: 校园网站的导航菜单标签采用了「高对比度」。

words.enDefinition: a group of display colours chosen to make text and interface elements easier to distinguish

examples.en: I chose a contrast theme that kept links easy to spot in my notes.
examples.zh: 我选了一个「对比度主题」，让笔记里的链接更显眼。

examples.en: The computer lab guide explained how to switch to a different contrast theme for reading.
examples.zh: 机房指南解释了如何切换到另一种「对比度主题」来阅读。

words.enDefinition: to reverse displayed colours so that light areas become dark and other colours change too

examples.en: I tried Invert Colors because the white background was too bright in the rehearsal room.
examples.zh: 排练室里看纯白背景有些刺眼，我试了「反转颜色」。

examples.en: The support page explains why some pictures look different after you tap Invert Colors.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了为什么点了「反转颜色」后，有些图片看起来会不同。

words.enDefinition: a setting that changes how colours are displayed to make some colours easier to distinguish

examples.en: I tried a colour filter to tell the different lines apart on the chart.
examples.zh: 我试着用「色彩滤镜」区分图表中的不同线条。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the tablet's colour filter was listed in the menu.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了菜单中的平板「色彩滤镜」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a display setting that shows the screen in shades from black to white

examples.en: I switched to grayscale mode before checking whether the handout relied on colour alone.
examples.zh: 我先切换到「灰度显示模式」，再检查讲义是否只靠颜色区分内容。

examples.en: The screenshots still looked clear in grayscale mode when we reviewed the instructions together.
examples.zh: 我们一起看操作说明时，截图在「灰度显示模式」下仍然清楚。

collocations: view a page in grayscale mode

words.enDefinition: to make interface elements less see-through so their contents stand out more clearly

examples.en: Turning on Reduce Transparency made the text over my wallpaper easier to read.
examples.zh: 打开「降低透明度」后，壁纸上面的文字更容易读清了。

examples.en: I selected Reduce Transparency while testing the menu on the seminar room's computer.
examples.zh: 我在研讨室电脑上测试菜单时，选了「降低透明度」。

words.enDefinition: a feature that uses visible outlines or marks to show which text or controls act as buttons

examples.en: I turned on Button Shapes so I could identify the controls in the reading app.
examples.zh: 我开启了「按钮形状」，方便辨认阅读应用里的控件。

examples.en: With Button Shapes enabled, the back button was easier to spot on my phone.
examples.zh: 开启「按钮形状」后，手机上的返回按钮更容易找了。

words.enDefinition: a visible highlight showing which control will respond to keyboard input

examples.en: The focus indicator showed which button I had reached after pressing the Tab key.
examples.zh: 按下 Tab 键后，「焦点指示标记」显示了当前选中的是哪个按钮。

examples.en: We made the focus indicator easier to see on the society's sign-up page.
examples.zh: 我们让社团报名页的「焦点指示标记」更显眼了。

words.enDefinition: moving between controls and using a device or website with the keyboard

examples.en: I used keyboard navigation to reach the search field without touching the mouse.
examples.zh: 我用「键盘导航」移到了搜索框，全程没碰鼠标。

examples.en: The student portal guide lists which keys are used for keyboard navigation in the menu.
examples.zh: 学生门户指南列出了菜单中用于「键盘导航」的按键。

words.enDefinition: a touch action that operates a screen reader or moves between elements it announces

examples.en: I learned a screen reader gesture to move to the next heading on the page.
examples.zh: 我学了一个「屏幕阅读器手势」，可以跳到页面中的下一个标题。

examples.en: The guide describes a screen reader gesture that reads from the top of the screen.
examples.zh: 指南介绍了一种「屏幕阅读器手势」，可以从屏幕顶端开始朗读。

words.enDefinition: a device that forms changing patterns of raised dots to display digital text in braille

examples.en: She used a refreshable braille display to read the list of assignments before class.
examples.zh: 她上课前用「可刷新盲文显示器」读了作业清单。

examples.en: The new refreshable braille display connected to the tablet we used for the demonstration.
examples.zh: 新的「可刷新盲文显示器」连上了我们演示用的平板。

collocations: read on a refreshable braille display

words.enDefinition: using spoken instructions to operate a device or its interface

examples.en: I enabled voice control so I could open the next page without using my hands.
examples.zh: 我启用了「语音控制」，这样不用动手就能打开下一页。

examples.en: The assistant used voice control to search the settings menu during our device workshop.
examples.zh: 设备工作坊上，工作人员用「语音控制」搜索了设置菜单。

words.enDefinition: a spoken instruction that tells a device or program to carry out an action

examples.en: I used a voice command to open the notes for my afternoon class.
examples.zh: 我用一条「语音指令」打开了下午那门课的笔记。

examples.en: The support guide gives an example of a voice command for selecting a menu item.
examples.zh: 支持指南举了一条「语音指令」的例子，演示如何选择菜单项。

words.enDefinition: an Android accessibility feature for operating a device with physical switches or other supported controls

examples.en: The university showed us how Switch Access worked on the Android tablet in the lab.
examples.zh: 学校给我们演示了实验室的安卓平板怎么用「辅助开关操作」。

examples.en: I tested switch access with the provided switches before the discussion group arrived that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上讨论小组到场前，我用配套开关测试了「辅助开关操作」。

words.enDefinition: an input device that can be activated in a way suited to the user's abilities

examples.en: The adaptive switch was connected to the tablet we used during the accessibility demonstration.
examples.zh: 「辅助操作开关」连在我们做无障碍演示时用的平板上。

examples.en: My tutor helped position the adaptive switch so it was within easy reach.
examples.zh: 导师帮忙把「辅助操作开关」放到了我容易够到的位置。

words.enDefinition: a keyboard displayed on the screen whose keys are selected without using a physical keyboard

examples.en: I used the on-screen keyboard to enter my name on the library's touchscreen computer.
examples.zh: 我用「屏幕键盘」在图书馆的触屏电脑上输入了自己的名字。

examples.en: The on-screen keyboard stayed visible while I filled in the rest of the form.
examples.zh: 我填表格剩下的部分时，「屏幕键盘」一直显示在屏幕上。

words.enDefinition: an accessibility feature that allows keys in a combination to be pressed one at a time

examples.en: I enabled Sticky Keys so I could use shortcuts without holding two keys together.
examples.zh: 我开启了「粘滞键」，不用同时按两个键也能用快捷键。

examples.en: The lab assistant showed me how to turn on Sticky Keys before the practical session.
examples.zh: 上实验课之前，实验室助理给我演示了如何打开「粘滞键」。

words.enDefinition: a Windows accessibility feature that can ignore brief or repeated key presses

examples.en: I turned on Filter Keys because I kept pressing some keys twice by accident.
examples.zh: 我经常不小心把某些键按两次，所以打开了「筛选键」。

examples.en: The help document explains which types of key press Filter Keys can ignore.
examples.zh: 帮助文档解释了「筛选键」可以忽略哪些按键操作。

words.enDefinition: an accessibility feature that lets keys on the keyboard move the mouse pointer

examples.en: I enabled Mouse Keys when I needed to move the pointer without a trackpad.
examples.zh: 我需要在不用触控板的情况下移动指针，于是启用了「鼠标键」。

examples.en: The tutor explained how to operate the pointer with Mouse Keys during the accessibility session.
examples.zh: 无障碍讲座上，导师讲解了如何用「鼠标键」控制指针。

words.enDefinition: settings that change how a touchscreen responds to taps, holds and other touch actions

examples.en: I opened Touch Accommodations to change how my tablet responded to quick taps in class.
examples.zh: 我打开「触控调节」，调整平板在课堂上对快速轻点的反应。

examples.en: The support adviser checked Touch Accommodations while helping me set up the borrowed device.
examples.zh: 支持人员帮我设置借来的设备时，查看了「触控调节」。

words.enDefinition: the minimum time a touch must be held before the device treats it as input

examples.en: I increased the hold duration to avoid opening items when I brushed the screen.
examples.zh: 我调长了「按住时长」，免得擦到屏幕时误打开项目。

examples.en: The guide explains how hold duration changes the way the tablet responds to your touch.
examples.zh: 指南解释了「按住时长」如何改变平板对触碰的反应。

words.enDefinition: how readily a touchscreen registers contact from a finger or compatible input device

examples.en: The touch sensitivity felt different after I put a new protector on the screen.
examples.zh: 更换屏幕保护膜后，我感觉「触控灵敏度」变了。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where to adjust touch sensitivity on the device from the lab.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了在机房设备上哪里可以调「触控灵敏度」。

words.enDefinition: an accessibility setting that treats multiple taps in a short time as one touch

examples.en: I turned on Ignore Repeat because quick double taps were causing problems in the app.
examples.zh: 我打开了「忽略重复触控」，因为快速连点两下会影响使用。

examples.en: The setup guide showed how to adjust Ignore Repeat on the device we borrowed.
examples.zh: 设置指南说明了怎样在借来的设备上调整「忽略重复触控」。

words.enDefinition: a touch setting that uses the first or last position of a touch to register a tap

examples.en: I enabled Tap Assistance to make the location of my taps more predictable on screen.
examples.zh: 我开启了「轻点辅助」，让屏幕记录的点按位置更符合预期。

examples.en: The help page explains the options for Tap Assistance and when each setting applies.
examples.zh: 帮助页面介绍了「轻点辅助」的不同选项，以及各自何时生效。

words.enDefinition: the area on a screen that responds when someone taps a control

examples.en: A larger touch target made the sign-up button easier to press on my phone.
examples.zh: 更大的「触控目标区域」让手机上的报名按钮更容易点中。

examples.en: We checked each touch target on the society's page while testing it for accessibility.
examples.zh: 测试社团网页的无障碍功能时，我们检查了每一个「触控目标区域」。

words.enDefinition: the speed at which a device reads text aloud or gives spoken feedback

examples.en: I lowered the speaking rate when the screen reader started reading unfamiliar names from class.
examples.zh: 屏幕阅读器开始读课上遇到的陌生名字时，我调低了「合成语音的语速」。

examples.en: The speaking rate on the borrowed tablet was faster than the one I normally use.
examples.zh: 借来的平板上，「合成语音的语速」比我平时用的快。

words.enDefinition: text generated as people speak or audio plays, displayed on screen with little delay

examples.en: I turned on live captions while watching the student society's talk in a noisy room.
examples.zh: 在嘈杂的房间观看学生社团的讲座时，我开启了「实时字幕」。

examples.en: The lecturer reminded us that live captions sometimes miss specialised terms and names from class.
examples.zh: 讲师提醒我们，「实时字幕」有时会漏掉课上的专业术语和人名。

words.enDefinition: the displayed size of captions on a video or device

examples.en: I increased the caption size so I could read the interview from farther away.
examples.zh: 我调大了「字幕字号」，这样坐得远一点也能看清访谈内容。

examples.en: The app lets viewers choose a caption size before they start playing the video.
examples.zh: 应用允许观众在播放视频前选择「字幕字号」。

words.enDefinition: the appearance of captions, such as their font, colour and background

examples.en: I changed the caption style to make the text clearer over the bright slides.
examples.zh: 我调整了「字幕样式」，让文字在明亮的幻灯片上更清楚。

examples.en: The new caption style added a dark background behind the words in the recording.
examples.zh: 新的「字幕样式」让录像中的字幕文字带上了深色背景。

words.enDefinition: sound combined into a single channel so both sides can play the same information

examples.en: I enabled mono audio so I could hear both audio channels through one earbud.
examples.zh: 我启用了「单声道音频」，这样只戴一只耳机也能听到两个声道的内容。

examples.en: The support adviser showed us where mono audio was listed in the accessibility menu.
examples.zh: 支持人员给我们指出了无障碍菜单中「单声道音频」的位置。

words.enDefinition: the relative volume of the sound sent to the left and right channels

examples.en: I adjusted the left-right audio balance while listening to the practice recording in the studio.
examples.zh: 我在录音室听练习录音时，调整了「左右声道平衡」。

examples.en: The tablet keeps its left-right audio balance setting on the same page as mono audio.
examples.zh: 平板的「左右声道平衡」与单声道音频设置在同一个页面。

words.enDefinition: the ability of a device to work suitably with certain hearing aids

examples.en: I checked hearing aid compatibility before choosing a phone from the university's loan programme.
examples.zh: 从学校借用计划里选手机前，我查看了「助听器兼容性」。

examples.en: The support page describes hearing aid compatibility and lists the device models students can borrow.
examples.zh: 支持页面说明了「助听器兼容性」，并列出了学生可以借的设备型号。

words.enDefinition: soft sounds a device plays to mask distractions or create a steadier sound environment

examples.en: I played background sounds on my phone while reading in the busy student lounge.
examples.zh: 学生休息区很嘈杂，我读书时用手机播放「背景音效」。

examples.en: The tablet offers several background sounds, including rain and the sound of a stream.
examples.zh: 平板提供多种「背景音效」，包括雨声和流水声。

collocations: adjust the volume of background sounds

words.enDefinition: a feature that detects selected sounds in the environment and lets the user know

examples.en: I enabled sound recognition so the phone could notify me when someone rang the doorbell.
examples.zh: 我启用了「环境声音识别」，这样有人按门铃时手机就能提醒我。

examples.en: The setup page lists the types of sounds included in the sound recognition feature.
examples.zh: 设置页面列出了「环境声音识别」功能能检测的声音类别。

words.enDefinition: options that control how content appears on a screen

examples.en: I opened display settings before connecting my laptop to the screen in class.
examples.zh: 把笔记本连上教室的屏幕之前，我打开了「显示设置」。

examples.en: The lab assistant reset the display settings after the projector showed a stretched image.
examples.zh: 投影画面变形后，机房助理重置了「显示设置」。

words.enDefinition: a feature that automatically changes a screen's brightness in response to surrounding light

examples.en: I left auto-brightness on while moving between the sunny courtyard and the library.
examples.zh: 我在阳光下的庭院和图书馆之间来回时，让「自动亮度调节」保持开启。

examples.en: The device guide explains why auto-brightness can change the screen when you step outside.
examples.zh: 设备指南解释了为什么走到户外时，「自动亮度调节」会改变屏幕亮度。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen control that changes brightness when you drag its handle

examples.en: I moved the brightness slider down before taking notes in the dark lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我在昏暗的讲堂里记笔记前，把「亮度滑块」往低处拖了点。

examples.en: The brightness slider appeared below the display options when I opened the settings app.
examples.zh: 打开设置应用后，「亮度滑块」出现在显示选项下方。

words.enDefinition: a change in the way content is oriented on a screen as the device turns

examples.en: My tablet's screen rotation made the map easier to view when I held it sideways.
examples.zh: 我横着拿平板时，「屏幕旋转」让地图更容易看。

examples.en: The drawing app supports screen rotation, so we could work in either position.
examples.zh: 绘图应用支持「屏幕旋转」，所以我们横着竖着都能画。

words.enDefinition: a setting that keeps the screen orientation fixed when the device turns

examples.en: I turned on rotation lock so the readings would stay upright on the bus.
examples.zh: 我开启了「旋转锁定」，这样在公交车上阅读时页面能保持竖向。

examples.en: The help button explains where to find rotation lock if the display will not turn.
examples.zh: 如果屏幕转不过来，帮助按钮会提示去哪里找「旋转锁定」。

words.enDefinition: an orientation in which the screen or content is wider than it is tall

examples.en: I switched to landscape orientation to see the entire timetable without scrolling sideways.
examples.zh: 我切换成「横向显示」，这样不用横向滚动就能看见整个时间表。

examples.en: The diagram was easier to follow in landscape orientation on the classroom tablet.
examples.zh: 在教室平板上用「横向显示」看那张图，内容更容易看懂。

words.enDefinition: an orientation in which the screen or content is taller than it is wide

examples.en: I chose portrait orientation when reading the long list of workshops on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上看那份很长的工作坊列表时，选了「纵向显示」。

examples.en: The form fit the screen properly in portrait orientation after the update that morning.
examples.zh: 当天早上更新后，表单在「纵向显示」时能正确适配屏幕了。

words.enDefinition: an accessibility option that reduces the intensity of bright colours on the display

examples.en: I tried Reduce White Point because bright areas of the reading app were distracting.
examples.zh: 阅读应用里亮的地方让我分心，我试了「降低白点值」。

examples.en: The guide showed where to adjust Reduce White Point on the tablet during setup.
examples.zh: 指南说明了设置平板时去哪里调「降低白点值」。

words.enDefinition: a Windows display setting that makes screen colours warmer, manually or on a schedule

examples.en: I turned on Night Light to make the screen look warmer before evening study.
examples.zh: 晚上学习之前，我打开了「夜间暖色显示」，让屏幕颜色更暖。

examples.en: The lab computer had Night Light scheduled to start just after the library closed.
examples.zh: 机房那台电脑把「夜间暖色显示」设在图书馆关门后不久开启。

words.enDefinition: how warm or cool the overall colour of a light or display appears

examples.en: I adjusted the colour temperature until the projector no longer made the slides look blue.
examples.zh: 我调整了「色温」，直到投影上的幻灯片不再偏蓝。

examples.en: The device lets you choose a warmer colour temperature when you read late at night.
examples.zh: 深夜阅读时，设备允许你选偏暖的「色温」。

words.enDefinition: the time a device waits without input before turning off its display

examples.en: I changed the screen timeout so the recipe would stay visible while I cooked.
examples.zh: 我修改了「屏幕熄灭等待时间」，这样做饭时菜谱不会很快消失。

examples.en: The screen timeout was too short while we used the tablet to read music.
examples.zh: 我们在平板上看乐谱时，「屏幕熄灭等待时间」太短了。

words.enDefinition: to make a device's display turn on after it has gone dark

examples.en: I tapped the tablet to wake the screen and check the next workshop time.
examples.zh: 我点了平板「唤醒屏幕」，查看下一场工作坊的时间。

examples.en: My laptop lets me wake the screen by touching the trackpad during a break.
examples.zh: 休息时，我轻碰笔记本触控板就能「唤醒屏幕」。

collocations: press a key to wake the screen

words.enDefinition: a paired or rocking control with one end for increasing volume and another for decreasing it

examples.en: I used the volume rocker to turn the sound down before entering the library.
examples.zh: 进图书馆之前，我用「音量翘板键」调低了声音。

examples.en: The case made the volume rocker hard to press while I was wearing gloves.
examples.zh: 戴着手套时，那个保护壳让「音量翘板键」不太好按。

words.enDefinition: a light, icon or other signal showing that a device is charging or its charging status

examples.en: The charging indicator lit up when I plugged in the tablet at the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆给平板接上电源后，「充电指示灯」亮了。

examples.en: I checked the charging indicator after moving to a different seat in the study area.
examples.zh: 我在自习区换了一个座位后，查看了「充电指示标志」。

words.enDefinition: a device that changes the incoming electrical supply to one suitable for another device

examples.en: I borrowed a compatible power adapter from the library desk when my laptop ran low.
examples.zh: 笔记本快没电时，我从图书馆服务台借了一个兼容的「电源适配器」。

examples.en: The power adapter for the loan tablet was listed separately on the return form.
examples.zh: 归还表上单独列出了借用平板的「电源适配器」。

words.enDefinition: a charger that plugs into a wall socket to supply power to a device

examples.en: I left my wall charger in the seminar room after borrowing an outlet near the door.
examples.zh: 我在门旁找插座充了会儿电，离开时把「插座式充电器」落在了研讨室。

examples.en: A wall charger was included with the tablet we borrowed for the workshop that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们为下午工作坊借的平板附带了一个「插座式充电器」。

words.enDefinition: a socket for the small reversible connector used on many computers and other devices

examples.en: I connected the lecture room adapter to the USB-C port on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我把讲堂里的适配器连到笔记本的「USB-C 接口」。

examples.en: The new tablet has a USB-C port on the side facing my desk.
examples.zh: 新平板朝向我桌子的一侧有一个「USB-C 接口」。

words.enDefinition: a device that adds multiple USB connections through a single port

examples.en: I used a USB hub to connect a mouse and a drive during class.
examples.zh: 我上课时用「USB 集线器」接上了鼠标和存储盘。

examples.en: The library loan desk had one USB hub left when my group arrived.
examples.zh: 我们小组到图书馆借用服务台时，那里只剩一个「USB 集线器」。

collocations: plug devices into a USB hub

words.enDefinition: an external device that connects equipment with different video interfaces

examples.en: I borrowed a USB-C to HDMI display adapter for the projector in our classroom.
examples.zh: 我借了一个 USB-C 转 HDMI 的「视频接口转接器」，用来连教室里的投影仪。

examples.en: The technician checked the display adapter before we began the student presentations that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午学生演示开始前，技术员检查了「视频接口转接器」。

words.enDefinition: a cable that carries video signals between a computer and a monitor

examples.en: I connected the monitor cable before opening the presentation notes on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我先接好「显示器连接线」，再打开笔记本上的演示备注。

examples.en: The monitor cable was missing from the equipment kit we borrowed for class.
examples.zh: 我们为课堂借来的设备套装里没有「显示器连接线」。

collocations: check both ends of the monitor cable

words.enDefinition: a screen connected to a device rather than built into it

examples.en: I used an external display so I could keep the assignment instructions visible too.
examples.zh: 我用了「外接显示器」，这样还能一直看着作业要求。

examples.en: The classroom computer recognised the external display as soon as we connected the cable.
examples.zh: 我们一接上连接线，教室电脑就认出了「外接显示器」。

words.enDefinition: showing the same image on two or more screens at once

examples.en: We turned on display mirroring so the audience could see the same slides.
examples.zh: 我们开启了「屏幕镜像」，这样观众就能看到同一份幻灯片。

examples.en: The presentation station supports display mirroring with both the projector and the monitor.
examples.zh: 演示台支持投影仪和显示器同时使用「屏幕镜像」。

words.enDefinition: to add another screen as extra workspace for a different part of the desktop

examples.en: I chose to extend the display so I could keep my notes separate from the slides.
examples.zh: 我选择「扩展显示」，这样笔记可以和幻灯片分开显示。

examples.en: The assistant explained how to extend the display on the study room's computer.
examples.zh: 工作人员讲了怎么在自习室的电脑上「扩展显示」。

collocations: extend the display to a second monitor
learn how to extend the display

words.enDefinition: a display option that shows the computer's output only on the connected screen

examples.en: I selected "Second screen only" to use the larger monitor at my study desk.
examples.zh: 我选了「仅用第二屏」，在书桌上用那台较大的显示器。

examples.en: After I chose "Second screen only", the image disappeared from the laptop's own display.
examples.zh: 选择「仅用第二屏」后，笔记本自带屏幕的画面就没了。

words.enDefinition: a display message indicating that the screen is receiving no video signal from the selected source

examples.en: The monitor showed "No signal" when I first sat down at the study station.
examples.zh: 我刚在自习工位坐下，显示器就显示「无信号」。

examples.en: I asked the attendant about "No signal" on the screen before starting my presentation.
examples.zh: 开始演示前，我向值班人员问起屏幕上的「无信号」提示。

collocations: see No signal on the monitor

words.enDefinition: the port or device from which a display is set to receive its picture

examples.en: We picked the correct input source on the projector before opening the first slide.
examples.zh: 打开第一张幻灯片前，我们在投影仪上选了正确的「输入信号源」。

examples.en: The monitor listed two options for the input source on its settings screen.
examples.zh: 显示器在设置页面上列出了两个「输入信号源」选项。

words.enDefinition: the number of pixels used to make up a displayed image, usually given as width by height

examples.en: I adjusted the display resolution after the text looked blurry on the borrowed monitor.
examples.zh: 借来的显示器上文字有点模糊，我调了「显示分辨率」。

examples.en: The helpdesk asked which display resolution I had selected for the classroom projector.
examples.zh: 服务台问我为教室投影仪选了哪个「显示分辨率」。

words.enDefinition: the number of times per second a display can update its image

examples.en: I checked the refresh rate after a video looked uneven on the borrowed monitor.
examples.zh: 视频在借来的显示器上播放得不流畅，我查看了「屏幕刷新率」。

examples.en: The settings page shows the current refresh rate beside the name of the monitor.
examples.zh: 设置页在显示器名称旁边列出了当前「屏幕刷新率」。

words.enDefinition: rapid repeated changes in the brightness or stability of a displayed image

examples.en: The lab assistant noticed the screen flicker before the first student started presenting.
examples.zh: 第一位学生开始演示前，机房助理注意到了「屏幕闪烁」。

examples.en: I reported screen flicker on the library computer after it happened twice that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午图书馆电脑出现两次「屏幕闪烁」后，我报了修。

words.enDefinition: a touch display that does not react when the user touches it

examples.en: I couldn't check in because the kiosk had an unresponsive touchscreen that morning.
examples.zh: 当天上午，自助机的「触摸屏没有响应」，我没能签到。

examples.en: The desk attendant replaced the loan tablet after I reported an unresponsive touchscreen.
examples.zh: 我报告借来的平板「触摸屏没有响应」后，服务台给我换了一台。

words.enDefinition: to make a device shut down and restart when its usual controls do not respond

examples.en: The support team told me when to force restart the tablet that had stopped responding.
examples.zh: 平板没反应后，支持团队告诉我什么时候可以「强制重启」。

examples.en: I asked how to force restart the loan device without losing my saved notes.
examples.zh: 我询问如何「强制重启」借来的设备，同时保住已经保存的笔记。

words.enDefinition: to turn the device off and start it again as part of normal operation

examples.en: I saved my notes before I chose to restart the device between classes.
examples.zh: 我在课间选择「重启设备」前，先保存了笔记。

examples.en: The instructions suggested that we restart the device after changing the sound settings.
examples.zh: 操作说明建议我们更改声音设置后「重启设备」。

collocations: save your work before you restart the device

words.enDefinition: to turn the power to equipment completely off and then bring it back on

examples.en: The technician asked me to power cycle the display before the seminar started.
examples.zh: 研讨课开始前，技术员请我给显示器「完全断电后重新通电」。

examples.en: We waited for the projector to cool before asking whether to power cycle it.
examples.zh: 我们等投影仪冷却下来后，才问能不能「完全断电后重新通电」。

collocations: instructions to power cycle a device

words.enDefinition: describes a device that is not receiving charge or whose battery charge is not increasing

examples.en: The tablet showed Not charging even though it was connected to the dock.
examples.zh: 尽管平板已经接到底座上，还是显示「未在充电」。

examples.en: I told the library desk that the borrowed laptop was not charging anymore.
examples.zh: 我告诉图书馆服务台，借来的笔记本现在「充不上电」。

collocations: laptop plugged in but not charging

words.enDefinition: describes a device receiving power more slowly than expected or usual

examples.en: My tablet displayed Charging slowly when I connected it to the old docking station.
examples.zh: 我把平板接到旧扩展坞时，它显示「充电缓慢」。

examples.en: I noticed that the laptop was charging slowly while I finished my lab report.
examples.zh: 我写完实验报告的过程中注意到，笔记本「充电缓慢」。

collocations: ask why it is charging slowly

words.enDefinition: the amount of battery charge left, shown as a percentage of a full charge

examples.en: The battery percentage dropped after I played a long video on the loan tablet.
examples.zh: 我在借来的平板上播放一段长视频后，「电池电量百分比」下降了。

examples.en: I enabled the battery percentage display so I could see exactly how much charge remained.
examples.zh: 我打开了「电池电量百分比」显示，这样就能确切知道还剩多少电量。

words.enDefinition: information about the current battery charge or whether a device is charging

examples.en: I checked the battery status before taking the loan tablet to the library.
examples.zh: 把借来的平板带去图书馆之前，我查看了「电池状态」。

examples.en: The device shows its battery status in the corner while I read course materials.
examples.zh: 我看课程材料时，设备在屏幕角落显示「电池状态」。

words.enDefinition: the loss of battery charge over time, especially when it happens faster than expected

examples.en: I noticed unusual battery drain after a long seminar with the tablet display on.
examples.zh: 平板屏幕开着上完一堂长研讨课后，我注意到「电量消耗」不太正常。

examples.en: The support adviser asked when the battery drain became noticeable during a typical day.
examples.zh: 支持人员问，平常一天里什么时候开始明显感觉到「电量消耗」。

words.enDefinition: files created for short-term use while an application or system carries out a task

examples.en: The support adviser explained which temporary files the operating system could clean up safely.
examples.zh: 支持人员解释了操作系统可以安全清理哪些「临时文件」。

examples.en: I checked how much space temporary files were using on the tablet we borrowed.
examples.zh: 我查看了我们借来的平板上「临时文件」占了多少空间。

words.enDefinition: the storage built into a device where it keeps apps, files and system data

examples.en: I checked the tablet's internal storage before saving the videos for our class.
examples.zh: 保存课堂视频前，我查看了平板的「内部存储」。

examples.en: The support guide shows how much internal storage the operating system already uses.
examples.zh: 支持指南说明了操作系统已经占用了多少「内部存储」。

words.enDefinition: information about how much disk or device space is being used and what uses it

examples.en: I reviewed storage usage to find which folders were taking up the most space.
examples.zh: 我查看了「存储占用情况」，找出哪些文件夹用掉的空间最多。

examples.en: My tablet shows storage usage by file type on the main settings page.
examples.zh: 我的平板在设置主页按文件类型显示「存储占用情况」。

words.enDefinition: a condition or message indicating that there is not enough space for an operation

examples.en: The app showed Insufficient storage when I tried to save the workshop recording.
examples.zh: 我试着保存工作坊录像时，应用显示「存储空间不足」。

examples.en: Because of insufficient storage, my tablet could not keep another copy of the presentation.
examples.zh: 由于「存储空间不足」，我的平板存不下演示文稿的另一份副本。

words.enDefinition: a notice that the temperature of a device is higher than its intended operating range

examples.en: I saw an overheating warning after leaving the tablet in direct sunlight during lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时我把平板放在阳光直射处，后来看到了一条「设备过热警告」。

examples.en: The desk attendant asked when the overheating warning had appeared on the borrowed laptop.
examples.zh: 服务台人员问，我借的笔记本是什么时候弹出「设备过热警告」的。

words.enDefinition: tests and checks that provide information about the condition or performance of a device

examples.en: The technician ran device diagnostics before issuing another laptop for my final project.
examples.zh: 技术员先运行了「设备诊断」，然后为我的期末项目借出另一台笔记本。

examples.en: I checked where to find device diagnostics in the university's equipment support guide.
examples.zh: 我在学校的设备支持指南里查了去哪里找「设备诊断」。

words.enDefinition: a fault or difficulty involving the physical components or connections of a device

examples.en: The technician suspected a hardware issue after trying the monitor with another computer.
examples.zh: 用另一台电脑试过显示器后，技术员怀疑有「硬件问题」。

examples.en: I reported a possible hardware issue with the keyboard in the student computer lab.
examples.zh: 我报修了学生机房键盘可能存在的「硬件问题」。

words.enDefinition: a fault or difficulty involving the programs or operating system on a device

examples.en: The helpdesk traced the software issue to the application we used in the workshop.
examples.zh: 服务台查出「软件问题」来自我们工作坊用的那个应用。

examples.en: I reported the software issue when the reading app stopped opening my saved notes.
examples.zh: 阅读应用打不开已保存的笔记后，我报告了这个「软件问题」。

words.enDefinition: instructions for identifying the cause of a problem and trying appropriate fixes

examples.en: I opened the troubleshooting guide after the lecture recording played without any sound.
examples.zh: 课堂录像播放时没有声音，我打开了「故障排查指南」。

examples.en: The support page provides a troubleshooting guide for common problems with borrowed tablets.
examples.zh: 支持页面为借用平板的常见问题提供了「故障排查指南」。

words.enDefinition: a notification or text explaining that something went wrong during an operation

examples.en: I copied the error message into my support request before closing the application.
examples.zh: 关闭应用前，我把「错误提示」复制到了求助单里。

examples.en: The error message appeared whenever I moved the folder to the external drive.
examples.zh: 每次我把文件夹移到外接存储盘时，都会出现这条「错误提示」。

words.enDefinition: a reference, often made of numbers or letters, identifying a particular kind of error

examples.en: The support adviser asked me to read the error code from the screen.
examples.zh: 支持人员请我念一下屏幕上的「错误代码」。

examples.en: I included the error code when I reported the problem with the loan tablet.
examples.zh: 我报告借来的平板有问题时，一并提供了「错误代码」。

words.enDefinition: to make a reported problem happen again so that it can be observed or investigated

examples.en: The support adviser asked whether I could reproduce the issue on another tablet.
examples.zh: 支持人员问，我能否在另一台平板上「复现问题」。

examples.en: I could only reproduce the issue when the laptop was connected to the projector.
examples.zh: 只有笔记本连上投影仪时，我才能「复现问题」。

collocations: be able to reproduce the issue

words.enDefinition: to explain what is going wrong and when or where it happens

examples.en: I tried to describe the problem without guessing what had caused the screen to flash.
examples.zh: 我尽量「描述问题」，没有去猜屏幕闪烁的原因。

examples.en: The form asks you to describe the problem before adding a screenshot or error code.
examples.zh: 表单要求先「描述问题」，再添加截图或错误代码。

collocations: ask someone to describe the problem

words.enDefinition: to get in touch with the service that helps users with a device

examples.en: I decided to contact device support because the tablet still would not recognise the charger.
examples.zh: 平板还是识别不了充电器，我决定「联系设备支持团队」。

examples.en: The loan desk showed me where to contact device support outside normal library hours.
examples.zh: 借用服务台告诉我，图书馆下班后可以去哪里「联系设备支持团队」。

collocations: learn how to contact device support

words.enDefinition: a code assigned to a particular physical device to identify it

examples.en: The assistant copied the device serial number onto the form when I returned the tablet.
examples.zh: 我归还平板时，工作人员把「设备序列号」抄到了表上。

examples.en: Support asked for the device serial number so they could check which computer I had borrowed.
examples.zh: 支持人员请我提供「设备序列号」，以确认我借的是哪台电脑。

words.enDefinition: a cable that does not carry power or signals properly

examples.en: The technician replaced the faulty cable before we started the presentations in class.
examples.zh: 课堂演示开始前，技术员换掉了「有故障的线缆」。

examples.en: We labelled the faulty cable so nobody would take it from the spare equipment drawer.
examples.zh: 我们给「有故障的线缆」贴了标签，免得有人从备用器材抽屉里拿走用。

words.enDefinition: a physical connection that does not fit securely and may interrupt power or a signal

examples.en: A loose connection made the sound cut out whenever someone moved the computer.
examples.zh: 只要有人移动电脑，「松动的连接」就会导致声音中断。

examples.en: The technician checked for a loose connection after the picture disappeared from the projector.
examples.zh: 投影画面消失后，技术员检查有没有「松动的连接」。

words.enDefinition: audio sent from a device, or its routing to a speaker, headphones or another destination

examples.en: I switched the audio output to my headphones before listening to the course recording.
examples.zh: 听课程录音前，我把「音频输出」切换到了耳机。

examples.en: The lab computer sent its audio output to the monitor instead of the room speakers.
examples.zh: 机房电脑把「音频输出」送到了显示器，没有走房间音箱。

words.enDefinition: sound received by a device from a microphone or another audio source

examples.en: The recording app showed audio input from the microphone clipped to my shirt.
examples.zh: 录音应用显示收到了夹在我衣服上的麦克风的「音频输入」。

examples.en: I checked the audio input before recording my part of the group project.
examples.zh: 录制自己负责的小组项目内容之前，我检查了「音频输入」。

words.enDefinition: hardware that receives information from a computer, such as a speaker, display or printer

examples.en: I chose the headphones as the output device in the sound settings before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我在声音设置里把耳机选为「输出设备」。

examples.en: The computer identified the projector as a new output device after we connected it.
examples.zh: 我们接上投影仪后，电脑把它识别为新的「输出设备」。

words.enDefinition: hardware that sends information to a computer, such as a keyboard, pointer or microphone

examples.en: The borrowed microphone appeared as a new input device when I opened the audio settings.
examples.zh: 我打开音频设置时，借来的麦克风显示为新的「输入设备」。

examples.en: The classroom tablet let us choose which input device to use when taking notes.
examples.zh: 教室里的平板允许我们选择记笔记时使用哪种「输入设备」。

words.enDefinition: to check that a microphone is working and picking up sound properly

examples.en: I used the recording app to test the microphone before our project interview.
examples.zh: 项目访谈前，我用录音应用「测试麦克风」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to test the microphone before the remote discussion began that morning.
examples.zh: 导师请我们在当天上午的远程讨论开始前先「测试麦克风」。

collocations: test the microphone before a call
use a recorder to test the microphone

words.enDefinition: to produce an example audio signal to check that an output device is working

examples.en: I clicked the speaker icon to play a test sound before the seminar began.
examples.zh: 研讨课开始前，我点了扬声器图标「播放测试音」。

examples.en: The assistant asked the computer to play a test sound through both speakers in the room.
examples.zh: 工作人员让电脑通过房间里的两个音箱「播放测试音」。

collocations: choose to play a test sound
play a test sound through headphones
press the button to play a test sound

words.enDefinition: a control that can adjust the level of multiple audio sources or applications separately

examples.en: I used the volume mixer to lower the music without changing the lecture recording.
examples.zh: 我用「音量混合器」调低音乐音量，同时保留课堂录音的音量。

examples.en: The support guide shows where to find the volume mixer on the study room computer.
examples.zh: 支持指南指明了自习室电脑的「音量混合器」在哪里。

collocations: adjust levels in the volume mixer

words.enDefinition: options for audio inputs, outputs, volume and other sound behaviour

examples.en: I opened sound settings to check which speaker the laptop was using that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，我打开「声音设置」，看笔记本在用哪个扬声器。

examples.en: The assistant checked the sound settings before replacing the microphone in the small classroom.
examples.zh: 工作人员更换小教室的麦克风前，先查看了「声音设置」。

words.enDefinition: describes the absence of audible output where sound would normally be expected

examples.en: There was no sound when I played the interview on the classroom computer.
examples.zh: 我在教室电脑上播放采访时，「没有声音」。

examples.en: I told the helpdesk that there was no sound from either speaker after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后我告诉服务台，两个扬声器都「没有声音」。

collocations: troubleshoot no sound from a device

words.enDefinition: a situation in which sound captured by the microphone is quieter than needed

examples.en: My partner noticed low microphone volume when we listened to the first practice recording.
examples.zh: 我们听第一段练习录音时，搭档发现了「麦克风输入音量过低」的问题。

examples.en: The helpdesk guide explains several common reasons for low microphone volume on borrowed laptops.
examples.zh: 服务台指南解释了借用笔记本出现「麦克风输入音量过低」的几种常见原因。

words.enDefinition: a physical control for turning a microphone's input off or on

examples.en: I pressed the microphone mute button on my headset before moving the chair.
examples.zh: 挪椅子之前，我按了耳麦上的「麦克风静音按钮」。

examples.en: The microphone mute button had a red light while I was setting up the recording.
examples.zh: 我准备录音时，「麦克风静音按钮」亮着红灯。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that the device has recognised a connected pair of headphones

examples.en: The computer showed "Headphones detected" as soon as I plugged them in for class.
examples.zh: 为了上课，我刚插上耳机，电脑就显示「检测到耳机」。

examples.en: I still saw "Headphones detected" after removing the headphones from the study station.
examples.zh: 从自习工位电脑上拔掉耳机后，我仍然看到了「检测到耳机」的提示。

words.enDefinition: using swipes or other touch gestures to move around a device's interface

examples.en: I switched to gesture navigation on the tablet so it worked like my phone.
examples.zh: 我在平板上切换成「手势导航」，这样用起来就和手机一样。

examples.en: The support page shows how to return to the home screen with gesture navigation.
examples.zh: 支持页面演示了怎样用「手势导航」回到主屏幕。

words.enDefinition: using three on-screen buttons for actions such as going back, going home and switching apps

examples.en: I used three-button navigation on the borrowed phone because the buttons stayed visible.
examples.zh: 我在借来的手机上用「三键导航」，因为按钮一直显示在屏幕上。

examples.en: The setup guide explains how to switch from gestures to three-button navigation when needed.
examples.zh: 设置指南解释了需要时怎样从手势切换到「三键导航」。

words.enDefinition: to touch an item on a screen and keep a finger there briefly

examples.en: I had to tap and hold the picture before the options appeared underneath it.
examples.zh: 我得「长按」图片，下方才会出现选项。

examples.en: The guide says to tap and hold an icon to display its shortcut menu.
examples.zh: 指南上说，要「长按」图标才会显示它的快捷菜单。

collocations: tap and hold to open a menu

words.enDefinition: to move a finger upward across a touchscreen to scroll or trigger an action

examples.en: I had to swipe up to see the rest of the schedule on my phone.
examples.zh: 我得「向上滑动」，才能在手机上看见日程的剩余部分。

examples.en: On my Android phone, I swipe up from the home screen to open the app drawer.
examples.zh: 在我的安卓手机上，我从主屏幕「向上滑动」，就能打开应用列表。

words.enDefinition: to move two fingers closer together or farther apart on a touchscreen to change the scale

examples.en: I used pinch to zoom to check the small labels on the campus map.
examples.zh: 我用「双指捏合缩放」看清了校园地图上的小字。

examples.en: The gallery app supports pinch to zoom when you are viewing a single photograph.
examples.zh: 单独查看一张照片时，相册应用支持「双指捏合缩放」。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen keyboard arranged in two groups with a gap between them

examples.en: I enabled the split keyboard so my thumbs could reach the keys on the tablet.
examples.zh: 我打开「分体屏幕键盘」，这样两只拇指都够得到平板上的按键。

examples.en: The setup guide shows how to join the two halves of the split keyboard again.
examples.zh: 设置指南演示了如何重新合并「分体屏幕键盘」的两半。

words.enDefinition: a separate keyboard that connects to a computer, tablet or other device

examples.en: I connected an external keyboard to the tablet before taking notes in the lecture.
examples.zh: 在讲堂里记笔记之前，我给平板接了一个「外接键盘」。

examples.en: The library lent me an external keyboard that worked with the tablet I borrowed.
examples.zh: 图书馆给我借了一个和那台借来的平板兼容的「外接键盘」。

words.enDefinition: a PDF containing tags that define structural roles such as headings, lists and tables

examples.en: The support team gave us a tagged PDF so students could navigate by headings.
examples.zh: 支持团队给了我们一份「带结构标签的 PDF」，学生可以按标题跳转。

examples.en: I checked that the tagged PDF identified the rows and columns in each table.
examples.zh: 我检查了「带结构标签的 PDF」是否标出了每张表中的行和列。

collocations: check a tagged PDF for accessibility

words.enDefinition: the sequence in which parts of a document or screen are read, including by assistive tools

examples.en: We checked the reading order of the handout after moving its diagram and captions.
examples.zh: 挪动讲义里的示意图和图注之后，我们检查了内容的「阅读顺序」。

examples.en: The reading order was clear even when the screen reader moved through the page aloud.
examples.zh: 即使用屏幕阅读器逐项朗读页面，「阅读顺序」也很清楚。

words.enDefinition: keys on a keyboard for media actions such as playing, pausing or changing volume

examples.en: I used the media keys to pause the lecture recording without switching away from my notes.
examples.zh: 我用「媒体控制键」暂停了课堂录音，没切走笔记页面。

examples.en: The media keys on the keyboard worked with the player we used in the language lab.
examples.zh: 键盘上的「媒体控制键」可以控制我们在语言实验室用的播放器。

words.enDefinition: describes a device that does not react to normal controls or input

examples.en: "Which buttons still work when the device is unresponsive?" the adviser asked during startup.
examples.zh: 设备启动时，支持人员问：「设备无响应」的情况下，还有哪些键能用？

examples.en: Our equipment guide explains what information to collect when the device is unresponsive in class.
examples.zh: 设备指南说明了课堂上「设备无响应」时要收集哪些信息。

collocations: the device is unresponsive after startup
check whether the device is unresponsive
the device is unresponsive to touch

words.enDefinition: the speed at which the text insertion point alternates between visible and hidden

examples.en: I adjusted the cursor blink rate before writing notes on the computer in the lab.
examples.zh: 我在机房电脑上记笔记前，调整了「光标闪烁频率」。

examples.en: The settings page lets you reduce the cursor blink rate while keeping the caret visible.
examples.zh: 设置页允许调低「光标闪烁频率」，文字输入光标仍然可见。
